post_title: File storage system integration
Template Vorlagen
The (non-admin) user needs to be able to create private templates for themselves.
The user needs Swiss court decisions to be chunked and cited at the "Erwägung" level rather than by fixed size, matching the court's own reasoning structure.
The user needs conditional formatting (e.g. colour, bold, flags) in Matrix Analysis cells, triggered by prompt results.
The user needs configurable citation length — shorter inline citations while keeping full-length citations available elsewhere.
The user needs custom, savable agents ("Gems") for recurring tasks.
The user needs to be able to collapse or minimize the question box so answers get more screen space.
The user needs to be able to create and use templates in multiple languages without creating a template per language.
The user needs to be able to create templates for Matrix Analysis.
The user needs to be able to duplicate an existing Matrix Analysis.
The user needs to be able to duplicate existing templates for reuse in similar use cases with slight variations.
The user needs to be able to resize Matrix Analysis column widths.
The user needs to have document citations for relevant passages not for the full document only.
Date/deadline calculations are almost always wrong when reference dates are entered (weekdays, week-based deadlines).
Marginal numbers (Randziffern) in responses are often too long to be usable.
No jump to the end of the chat when closing a table
RVG and court-cost calculations are wildly wrong — amounts are not correctly taken from the tables.
Required user input is not visible when applying a template — the user must click 'edit' to see it.
The user expects the tool to adhere to his instructions (e.g. limitations to sources of interest).
The user needs a single, unambiguous login entry point instead of two confusing options (publisher portal vs. direct app link).
The user needs an "Artefakte" section that surfaces uploaded documents alongside citations, and eventually the playbook used.
The user needs an option to prevent accidental message submission when pressing Enter.
The user needs the tool to not be influenced by an arguing user unless the tool actually uncovers new information in the system, that changes the result.
The user needs transparency on how to add user input to a template.
The user needs voice input for long transcription of dictated text or meetings.
User-input instructions are not displayed for file inputs, even when essential.
